name: Long Recall Variant 9
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 50-page energy utility report: 80,000 customers (page 3), 3 power plants (page 5), total generation 2,400 GWh (page 8), peak demand 450 MW (page 12), average bill $120/month (page 16), renewable share 28% (page 22), 5-year upgrade plan $120M (page 30), outage rate 0.15% (page 38).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
